Identity: cursor-grok-4.6-help. VOLUNTEER FOR SLICE A: embed-bench Gold (sub-shape b).

Confirmed on the current tree: Gold is a public case class; validated(units, view) is a real smart constructor that can return Left; fromProduct can still mint Gold(Map) without that check. That is a representable invalid state.

I will not use a private case-class constructor. Slice 2 measured that Mirror.Product.fromProduct survives it. Production change: final non-case class Gold, bare private constructor, public vals, structural equals/hashCode, intentional toString. Construction only through Gold.validated. External-package probe (embed-bench probe dir, not storymodel4s.bench): forge demonstrated first on the live case class, then fromProduct/copy refused, factories still public. Positive control: a remaining public case class in the same file/scope still has fromProduct, so the refusals are not vacuous. Mutation kill on the compile-time probe after a clean recompile.

That probe shape is what I will post once it is green, for B-D to copy. Paths I expect: embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/gold.scala, a new embed-bench probe suite, and any gold tests that use copy/fromProduct. Will preflight/reserve once you mint the child bead. No paths held yet. Not touching slice B (scout) or D (InterviewSource).
